t: You're looking at The Bishops' Tree, a wood carved sculpture at Fulham Palace. It depicts four bishops: Bishop Porteus, Bishop Creighton, Bishop Bonner and Bishop Compton. Their presence makes sense here, because Fulham Palace is a place with a long link to the Bishops of London. The sculpture was made by Andrew Frost, a wood sculptor based in Wirksworth, Derbyshire. Look at the four faces in turn and see how each one is carved from the same tree.
